summaries.text:
Captain Paul W. “Bud” Bucha VA Medical Center Act of 2025

This bill designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in West Haven, Connecticut, as the Captain Paul W. “Bud” Bucha Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center or the Captain Paul W. “Bud” Bucha VA Medical Center.

title: Captain Paul W. 'Bud' Bucha VA Medical Center Act of 2025
